messages:
lina: quick sync playground: streaming display & controls. want feedback on an approach: 1) make the Stop control an overlay icon top-right of the message bubble (semi-transparent until hover) to avoid pushing content, 2) token counter as a floating micro-overlay (bottom-left of message) rather than a full rail, 3) introduce an "undo stop" chip in the toast that appears for 6s when someone stops the stream, 4) accessibility: what announcements and focus moves do we need? mike: sounds promising. overlay keeps layout stable. curious about discoverability on mobile though. maybe show the overlay when the message is long-pressed/tapped and keep an inline small "Stop stream" text action under the message only on small screens. tera: dev constraints: overlay is easy with absolute positioning. need to ensure it doesn't intercept text selection. will add pointer-events handling and a larger hit target for touch. the token micro-overlay can update at 300ms throttle to cut repaint costs. noah: copy idea: overlay icon has tooltip "Stop stream (Esc)" and the toast reads "Stream paused Undo" (where Undo is a button). prefer "paused" vs "stopped" because we offer resume. also show a small badge "partial" on the message while streaming. priya: accessibility: for live updates we should use aria-live="polite" on a visually-hidden live region per message, not a global one, so SR users can get granular updates. on manual stop set focus to the toast's undo button so keyboard users can resume quickly. sample markup: ```html Streaming
Stream paused
``` Also, for resumed streams add "aria-hidden=true" on earlier partial nodes so screen readers don't re-read everything. lina: nice. UX question: do we show the token counter during streaming or only after the message finalizes? I worry about distracting users with fluctuating numbers. mike: show a subtle counter (e.g., "~120 tokens") during streaming with reduced contrast. full precise counts only after completion or in tooltip. tooltip should include "Visible / Billable" breakdown. tera: engineering trade: we can compute a live approximate visible token count cheaply at client side; billable estimate needs a quick server call or local tokenizer. compromise: show approx client-side and a link "Estimate billable" which triggers the accurate calc in background. noah: mobile layout: if we use overlay + inline fallback, add a small animation so users notice the overlay appear on new messages. micro-anim: fade-in 150ms, no motion preference respect. priya: a11y checklist for the change: 1) ensure overlay icon has accessible name and keyboard focus 2) toast role=status and focus management for undo 3) aria-live per-message polite updates 4) tests for screen readers with resumed stream not re-reading old content. I'll draft test cases. lina: decision proposal: implement overlay Stop on desktop, inline Stop stream action on mobile, token micro-overlay visible but low-contrast while streaming, toast with accessible undo that tries to resume from cached state first. if cache not available, undo re-runs request and analytics tag says "undo:restart". mike: implementing shortcut: Esc cancels current stream, "r" when focused on message opens regenerate flow. will add key handlers. tera: timeline: I can prototype overlay + throttled counter this sprint. need final copy from design. lina: I'll update the mock with the overlay states and send a short video. review tomorrow 11am PT. thanks all :raised_hands: a11y-bot: detected aria-live usage in thread. reminder: include a clear accessible name for undo button and document focus behavior in PR description.
